bull_case: 2023–H1 2026 profit, margin, cash flow and backlog show a broad operating inflection.
bear_case: Much improvement reflects a favorable transformer cycle, not only self-help.
thesis: Operating inflection is real, but HDHE is no longer a classic distressed turnaround; the question is sustaining normalized returns.

evidence.claim: Operating profit rose from ₩315.2bn in 2023 to ₩669.0bn in 2024 and ₩995.3bn in 2025.
H1 2026 operating profit was ₩545.3bn on ₩2.178tn revenue (~25.0% margin).

counterevidence: Cycle is a major external driver.
Valuation already recognizes much of the recovery.
falsifiers: If new capacity causes utilization and margin to fall without FCF/share growth, the normalization bridge breaks.

subscores.rationale: Multiple years show broad realized profit/margin/OCF/backlog improvement.
Capacity, mix and execution are controllable, but global cycle is a major contributor.
Backlog and capacity additions provide a numeric bridge, with peak-margin risk retained.
Factory expansions have dated milestones, but this is not a formal distressed-turnaround KPI program.
